Job Description
 Ciklum is looking for a .NET Engineer (MAUI) to join our team full-time in Romania.
We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.
 About The Role
 As a .NET Engineer (MAUI) , become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. This project is with a global Financial Services Provider that focuses on providing responsible credit to underbanked customers in international markets. The current strategy centers on consolidating technology delivery to a single partner to drive efficiency and operational excellence. You will join the Customer Application. The primary mobile application serves as a critical self-service tool for over 800,000 users. It is currently undergoing a technology refresh, migrating to a modern framework to improve scalability, performance, and accessibility compliance across the organization's European footprint.
 Responsibilities
Develop complex solutions comprising Amazon AWS cloud infrastructure and platform services
Utilise automated deployment methods effectively within the project delivery
Communicate effectively with both peers and delivery team stakeholders
 Requirements
Minimum 3 years of experience as a Developer developing complex solutions using .Net MAUI
Competency in .Net MAUI, Typescript/Javascript, Google Play, App Store Connect, and Firebase Services (Push, Crashlytics)
Expert level Git/source control (branching & pull requests)
Competency in JIRA, Confluence, and SCRUM software development processes
Fluent English speaking and excellent Attention to detail (Expert level)
Must obtain a valid AWS Certified Developer – Associate certificate within 6 months of providing services
 Desirable
Competency in Snyk or equivalent security tooling
Competency in Kibana or equivalent logging solutions
Competency in technical communication, prioritization, and self-sufficiency
 What’s in it for you?
Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
Enjoy radical flexibility – work remotely or from an office, your choice
Care: Medical subscription to Regina Maria, meal tickets of 40 ron net/day worked
 About Us
 At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.
In Romania, we welcome top-tier tech talent — whether from our Bucharest office or fully remotely. Tap into deep industry knowledge, grow your career, and make an impact in an empowering environment.
 Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!
 Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.
